insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 45% women's / 38% men's. Alo skews 53% women's, Gymshark 22% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +8% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (148) vs Lululemon (93). Vuori leads by 55.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 47% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1251 vs 727 products. A 72% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 502 products. Behind Gymshark (961).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 472 products vs Lululemon's 244. Key for cooler weather expansion.
Market context: 22,983 competitor products tracked. Vuori's 3,275 = 12% share of tracked catalog.
